question: Authenticated truth of the /v1/graph payload the Next demo consumes: node/edge counts, per-node facets available for color, truncation honesty, D13 scope, and whether a types= filter exists.
answer: 1803 nodes / 987 edges (3182 REFUTED, ~1804 off-by-one). Node fields are EXACTLY {id,type,title,doc_id,phantom} — no kind, no status; `type` IS a real 6-value facet (task 996, paper 551, tag 146, command 22, metric 6, session 3) plus 79 type:null phantoms, so fullColor is viable TODAY, but the template palette TYPE_HEX only colors task+paper — 235 of 1803 nodes (13%) fall to SLATE. truncated:false is returned but is a HALF-TRUTH: the flag only covers the 2000-node budget; the per-type limit:1000 in graph_corpus silently caps tasks at 996 while ~3100 published tasks exist, so the graph is a ~26%-of-corpus fragment reported as complete. No types= param exists (graph_corpus ignores params entirely) — it is a NEW capability. D13 CONFIRMED on origin/main: :api pipeline = OptionalToken (assigns only :api_token) -> AssignDefaultScope, and scope_opts/1 reads only :current_workspace/:current_project, so token binding is structurally ignored and the graph is always the seeded Default workspace.

recipes.claim: Live authenticated graph = 1803 nodes, 987 edges, fields {id,type,title,doc_id,phantom}, truncated:false
recipes.rerun: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open(\"$HOME/.config/barkpark/config.json\"))[\"token\"])')" 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/graph?dataset=production' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(len(d["nodes"]),len(d["edges"]),list(d["nodes"][0].keys()),{k:d.get(k) for k in ("truncated","truncation_reason")})'

recipes.claim: type is a 6-value facet + 79 type:null phantoms; no other facet exists
recipes.rerun: curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/graph?dataset=production' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;from collections import Counter;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(Counter((str(n.get("type")),n["phantom"]) for n in d["nodes"]))'
recipes.expect: Counter({('task', False): 996, ('paper', False): 551, ('tag', False): 146, ('None', True): 79, ('command', False): 22, ('metric', False): 6, ('session', False): 3})

recipes.claim: types= is silently ignored (no filter capability on the route)
graph_corpus ignores all params and applies limit:1000 per type
The 996 task nodes are a silent truncation: ~3100 published tasks exist
D13: /v1/graph rides :api, whose OptionalToken assigns ONLY :api_token; AssignDefaultScope supplies the Default workspace
recipes.rerun: git show origin/main:api/lib/barkpark_web/plugs/optional_token.ex | grep -n assign; git show origin/main:api/lib/barkpark_web/router.ex | sed -n '30,47p'
recipes.expect: only `assign(conn, :api_token, token)`; pipeline :api ends OptionalToken -> AssignDefaultScope (no DeriveWorkspaceFromToken)

recipes.claim: Deployed Next demo embeds the SAME 1803/987 payload — graph DATA is live even though the deploy is stale
recipes.expect: task 996, paper 551, tag 146, _unknown 79, command 22, metric 6, session 3; from_id 987

recipes.claim: TYPE_HEX covers neither tag, command, metric nor session
